faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Power Foundation of India (PFI) for filling up positions under its Regulatory & Research Division located in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in PFI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Senior Analyst - Research, requiring candidates with specialized qualifications in engineering and management fields related to power and energy.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Analyst - Research post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Analyst - Research position under this recruitment notification published by the Power Foundation of India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for PFI Senior Analyst?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical/Power) along with an MBA in Power/Energy/Finance or an M.Tech degree in an Energy related field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 28 years, calculated as on the closing date of application specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for PFI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates must download the application format from the official website and submit it accordingly.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form in the prescribed format is 30 November 2026 up to 06:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q8. What salary will be offered to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The CTC of the selected candidate shall be protected, and an additional increase ranging from 10% to 30% over their existing CTC may be offered.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification and the prescribed application form from the Power Foundation of India official website under the Careers section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Analyst - Research post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises verification of candidate credentials and fulfillment of the organization's applicable service rules and eligibility criteria.
